resources.name: Crucial Music
resources.description: Non-exclusive sync agency with personalized service. 50/50 sync fee split; you keep 100% writer royalties. Must own masters and be registered with a PRO. Requires three-year contract if accepted.

resources.name: Songtradr
resources.description: Global marketplace with AI-powered matching. Starter Plan (Free): 90% distribution royalties, 60% sync fees. Pro Plan ($49/yr): 100% distribution royalties, 80% sync fees. Lite Plan available at $19/yr. Non-exclusive.

resources.name: Bodega Sync
resources.description: Division of Symphonic Distribution. Curated roster of indie artists/labels. Standard deal: two-year exclusive contract with 30% commission on sync fees. Symphonic clients get priority for weekly email blast 'Checkout'. Non-Symphonic clients can apply.

resources.name: Artist Portal Studio
resources.description: Open-call platform for specific sync briefs. Tiered model with free tier for exploratory submissions and paid tiers for active artists. Submit music for consideration on TV, film, trailer, and commercial placements. Hundreds of live briefs monthly.
resources.cost: Free tier available; paid tiers available

resources.name: Directional Music
resources.description: Flexible contracts with support for independent artists. Focus on indie films and digital content. Smaller catalog with hands-on approach. SUBMISSIONS CURRENTLY CLOSED - please check back soon.

resources.name: TAXI
resources.description: Established in 1992. Publishes screened music-wanted listings from supervisors, labels, ad agencies, and game companies. Screeners review and forward qualifying tracks. You keep your own deals.

resources.name: Music Gateway
resources.description: Partnerships with Disney, Netflix, Universal. 75–80% artist payout. You keep 100% backend royalties. Pitches to execs in London and LA. NOTE: Free tier was eliminated as of January 31, 2025.

resources.name: Broadjam
resources.description: Connects 110,000+ artists with supervisors and ad agencies. Four membership levels: Mini (free, $20/submission); MoB ($4.95/month or $49.95/year, $15/submission); Film/TV ($9.95/month or $99.95/year, $5/submission); Primo ($19.95–$49.95/month or $199.95/year, $5/submission). Artists keep 100% of sync fees and PRO royalties.

resources.name: Musicbed
resources.description: Premium placements with brands like Nike, Coca-Cola, Netflix, Adobe. High-quality curated catalog for film and advertising. CURRENTLY CLOSED TO UNSOLICITED SUBMISSIONS - requires invitation or networking. Sign up for notifications instead.

resources.name: Marmoset
resources.description: Indie-focused, creative approach. Non-exclusive deals, typically 50/50 split on licensing fees. Has paid $22M+ to artists since 2017. Very selective about accepting new music.

resources.name: Audio Network
resources.description: One of the largest global sync libraries with 200,000+ tracks. Transparent pricing, broadcast-ready music. International roster of composers. Selective about accepting new composers.

resources.name: Jingle Punks
resources.description: Award-winning agency with offices in NYC, LA, Toronto, London. 500,000+ song library, 4,000+ artists. NOT ACCEPTING NEW ARTIST SUBMISSIONS at this time. When open: Exclusive contracts, typically 50/50 split, usually 1-year auto-renewable.

resources.name: Nightingale Music
resources.description: 30+ years of experience. Custom pricing per project. Strong in Canadian and international productions. Personal support. Submission process can be opaque.

resources.name: Pond5
resources.description: One of the largest royalty-free media marketplaces (25M+ stock clips). Artists upload tracks and set their own prices. Updated January 2025: Artists now earn 30% royalty (non-exclusive) or 40% (exclusive video). Previously took 70% - still takes similar cut but rates are simplified and lower for some artist types.
resources.cost: Free to upload; Pond5 takes 70% commission (artists earn 30%)

resources.name: Artlist
resources.description: Subscription model for buyers. Curated catalog with high production standards. Popular with content creators and filmmakers. Non-exclusive deals.

resources.name: Epidemic Sound
resources.description: Artists receive upfront payments and revenue shares. 50/50 royalty split plus access to $2M annual Soundtrack bonus pool. IMPORTANT: Works exclusively with artists NOT registered with PROs. PRO members cannot participate.

resources.name: Jamendo
resources.description: Accessible platform for indie musicians. Free uploads, both exclusive and non-exclusive deals available. Unlimited submissions. Revenue share ranges from 30% to 65% depending on sales volume and exclusivity. YouTube Content ID integration.

resources.name: That Pitch
resources.description: Distributes your tracks to 100+ sync libraries worldwide. Handles metadata and compliance. You keep 100% of earnings. Free tier grants unlimited uploads to one library; paid tier unlocks 100+ libraries and briefs. Nearly 10-year track record with tens of thousands of placements.
resources.cost: Free tier (1 library); paid tier for 100+ libraries

resources.name: Ditto Pro (Sync Dashboard)
resources.description: Ditto Pro subscribers access sync briefs across TV, film, and ad campaigns at $29/year. Dashboard offers curated access to latest sync opportunities. Ditto reviews tracks and pitches on your behalf.

resources.name: Music Xray
resources.description: Submit songs for professional critique and sync opportunities. Connects directly with opportunity providers. Pricing: $10 first submission per song (Diagnostics evaluation tool), plus $5 transaction fee, plus $4-$35 submission fee per opportunity. Total costs vary.

resources.name: UnitedMasters SELECT
resources.description: SELECT members submit music for sync and brand deals (NBA, ESPN, etc.). Also provides distribution. Price increased: SELECT Plan is now $59.99/year (artists keep 100% of royalties). Free tier available with 10% deduction from royalties.

resources.name: Sync Money
resources.description: Community-focused platform for music makers. Real opportunities for TV, Film, Advertising, Video games. Exclusive resources, networking opportunities, personalized guidance. Curated briefs sent directly via newsletter.

resources.name: Nitrility
resources.description: Blockchain-powered platform for sync licensing. Search, request, negotiate, and clear licenses for 200M+ song catalog. Trusted by 80,000+ artists, labels, and publishers. Includes AI-search, expert curation, automated notifications, contract handling, payments, and dispute protection.

resources.name: One Night Stand Music & Management
resources.description: Unique subscription-based sync licensing model. Direct pitching to film, TV, ads, gaming. Artists keep ownership of music. Flat subscription replaces commission model. Transparent, flexible approach focused on artist control.

resources.name: Millennial Mind Sync — Supervisor Directory
resources.description: 325+ music supervisors indexed with LinkedIn profiles, email contact methods, and project histories. Includes a free pitch email generator tool.

resources.name: SongwriterUniverse — Supervisors Directory
resources.description: Free list of music supervisors in the US, Canada, and UK with company names, addresses, and contact info.

resources.name: Guild of Music Supervisors
resources.description: Non-profit organization for music supervision professionals. Member directory, news, events. Useful for researching who supervises what.

resources.name: Aristake — Sync Agents Guide
resources.description: Free guide listing sync agents and how to get music synced on TV, video games, and films.

resources.name: Musco Sound — Library Submission Guide
resources.description: Free guide with direct links to submit music to various tiers of sync libraries. Updated content as of February 2026.

resources.name: IMDb / IMDb Pro
resources.description: Look up music supervisors by searching film/TV credits. IMDb Pro provides contact details and project history.

resources.name: The Sync Report
resources.description: 1,000+ music supervisors, music buyers, and ad agency contacts in USA, UK, Canada, and Australia. TV calendar for optimal pitch timing. (Status: verify directly with site for current availability.)

resources.name: Music Business Registry — Film & TV Music Guide
resources.description: Industry-standard directory for 30+ years. 8,194+ professional contacts with direct phone/email. Covers supervisors, studios, licensing execs, game companies. (Status: verify directly with site.)

resources.name: Underground Mix — Sync Library Submission List
resources.description: 120+ vetted sync libraries, micro-licensing sites, and music houses. Includes submission checklist and email pitch template. Created by former Extreme Music / Paramount / Sony professionals. (Status: verify URL directly.)

resources.name: Music Supervisors Directory
resources.description: Curated directory of music supervisor contacts in LA, NYC, London, Canada, and Australia. Updated monthly. (Status: verify directly with site.)

resources.name: Sync Music Library Directory
resources.description: Database of ~270 active exclusive libraries and ~40 royalty-free libraries. Designed for producers, artists, and composers. (Status: verify directly with site.)

resources.name: Songtrust — Sync Crash Course
resources.description: Free crash course covering sync licensing fundamentals: deal structures, sync fees, rights, placement types, and royalty collection.

resources.name: The Sync Lab (Aaron Davison)
resources.description: Free 4-hour video course covering how to create sync-ready music, pitch effectively, and land placements. Includes a free licensing directory. Aaron Davison is widely cited in 2025 sync discussions.

resources.name: Dark Horse Institute — Sync Guide
resources.description: Blog with strategies and tips for getting sync placements as an independent musician. Part of Dark Horse Institute's music education programs.

resources.name: Collabhouse — Demystifying Sync Licensing
resources.description: Guide explaining how sync licensing works as a revenue stream and exposure tool for independent artists.

resources.name: 2Indie — The Sync Society
resources.description: Private music licensing club. Weekly Zoom calls with industry professionals (sync agencies, supervisors, producers). Monthly curated sync sampler sent to agencies. (Status: verify directly with site.)

resources.name: Master Music Licensing (Michael Elsner)
resources.description: 4-step course from an instructor with 2,500+ placements. Includes private mastermind group community. (Status: verify directly with site.)

resources.name: Ari's Take Academy — Advanced Sync Strategies
resources.description: Course on sync licensing including how to get signed to agents. Includes showcases with top-tier sync agencies and direct submission opportunities. Ari Herstand is a well-known industry author and educator.

resources.name: Sync My Music
resources.description: Sync licensing course for producers covering creating licensable music, finding libraries, and building income through performance royalties. (Status: verify directly with site.)

resources.name: ThatPitch Blog
resources.description: Extensive articles on sync licensing opportunities, companies, fees, strategies, and trends. Very prolific with numerous 2025 articles confirmed.

resources.name: Millennial Mind Sync Blog
resources.description: Articles on sync libraries, music supervisors, submission strategies, and free tools (pitch generator, pricing calculator).

resources.name: Stock Music Musician
resources.description: Blog focused on production music and sync library submissions with reviews and guides. Lists best libraries accepting submissions based on author's licensing earnings.

resources.description: Podcast connecting songwriters with the sync licensing industry. (Status: verify current episode activity on Apple Podcasts.)

resources.description: Personal accounts and guides on navigating sync licensing as an indie musician. (Status: verify directly with site.)

resources.description: Articles on how sync licensing empowers independent artists outside traditional label structures. (Status: verify directly with site.)
